summary: Added a first-party `ask_user` tool to Gizmo's agent server that blocks on the existing extension-UI bridge, and added frontend rendering of those select/input prompts as inline chat question cards instead of modal dialogs. Backend wiring is in place; frontend work is in progress (store changes made, new PiExtensionQuestion.svelte written) but not yet wired into Conversation.svelte or verified.
decisions: ask_user is implemented as an agent-server tool (apps/agent-server/src/tools/ask-user-tool.ts) that reuses the existing PiExtensionUiRuntime select/input round-trip, rather than introducing a new Pi extension package.
Modal PiExtensionDialogs are now restricted to confirm/editor requests only; select and input requests render inline in chat as agent questions.
Free-text 'Write my own answer…' is always appended as the last multiple-choice option so the user can override the offered choices.
If the user cancels/skips a question the tool returns a structured 'no answer' result with details.answer = null instead of throwing, so the agent loop continues.
errors: Initial edit attempt against PiExtensionUiStore.svelte.ts was rejected as a no-op (identical old/new text); the subsequent edit with the real dialogFor change succeeded.

Multiple exploratory `grep`/`ls` commands returned no output (e.g. searching node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent for 'ask_user', searching apps/packages for the string) before the assistant concluded ask_user is not a pi built-in tool.
